content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97 (bundled into another paid service), which is a coding/bundling issue, not a medical-necessity dispute—so the prior necessity appeal missed the target. The correct remedy for CO-97 is to unbundle via an appropriate modifier (e.g., 59/XU) demonstrating the service is distinct and separately payable, then resubmit. Prior auth isn't required here and retro-auth isn't offered, so those paths are irrelevant, and 27 days of timely filing remain to correct and resubmit.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
